title: Road to bigger abs
summary: He admits he has only a faint four-pack and undefined obliques and needs to lose fat. Since a deficit would stall his size goals, he plans to stay at maintenance calories and get stronger to slowly lose fat while gaining muscle.

claims.claim: He has no six-pack: only a small, barely visible four-pack and poorly defined obliques, and needs to lose fat.
His ab goal is visible obliques from the side first, then a six-pack from the front.
Being in a calorie deficit would make it impossible to grow his arms to 19 inches.
His plan is to stay at the same calories and get stronger, dropping fat while gaining muscle, accepting it will be slow.
There is no point being big with too high a bodyfat.
